rubric.10: exceptional fit, exceeds all must-haves, exact target role, no anti-flags
rubric.8: strong match, meets all must-haves, seniority aligns
rubric.6: partial, ~70% must-haves OR seniority off 1 level OR cross-domain

methodology_basis: Zheng et al. 2023 — anchor-only ordinal, per-rating rationale required, no intermediate values

safety_set.description: 11 fresh CVs (never seen during prompt iteration) × tech vacancies. Tests rejection capability for catastrophic mismatches.

coverage_set.description: 14 dev CVs and 11 fresh non-tech CVs paired with vacancies they were never paired with in the development gold (391-pair set). Includes both never-paired same-pool pairs (vacancies seen during prompt iteration but in different pairings) and fully-fresh-vacancy pairs (vacancies scraped after prompt was frozen, never seen by the model). 126 pairs use freshly-scraped vacancies.

strong_fit_set.description: Initial strong-fit subset merged into coverage_set after expansion to 272 pairs.

fresh_vacancy_extension.description: Variant B expansion (2026-06-10): 300 freshly-scraped vacancies normalised after prompt v1_6 was frozen, paired with 25 CVs across role families. Fully-fresh held-out — neither CV-side nor vacancy-side leakage. Retires the 'vacancy-pool partial leakage' limitation.
fresh_vacancy_extension.vacancy_source: work.ua + djinni.co, non-tech queries (legal, finance, HR, marketing, sales, design, healthcare, security)

test_retest.rater_pass_2: Claude Opus 4.7 with rephrased rubric (alternative anchor phrasing)

limitations.single_rater_family: All ratings produced by Claude Opus 4.7 (Anthropic). Cross-provider Krippendorff alpha not assessed.
limitations.vacancy_pool_seen: Coverage and strong-fit subsets draw vacancies from the development pool (seen during prompt iteration). Pairs were never rated, but vacancy text was seen. Safety subset has fresh CVs guaranteed never seen.
limitations.system_under_test_provider: System being evaluated (Gemini 2.5 Flash, Google) is a different provider from the rater (Claude Opus 4.7, Anthropic). Reduces but does not eliminate LLM-consensus risk.
